title: New customization options for the banner
description:
Admins can now customize the callout banner on the Customer Service Management support site with new configuration options. These updates allow you to adjust the banner size, background, text color, and alignment to better match your organization's branding. To configure the banner: Log in to Customer Service Management.
	Select Channels, then Support website.
	Select the Edit icon to open the editor.
	Select the Page topper component to view the new configuration options.
	Select your preferred
